evidence.claim: Graph-feature scorer trained on 5,565 closed cases gives this transaction a calibrated fraud probability of 0.00 (bank model score 0.77); features include Vesta's unnamed C, D, M and V columns, used as signals only
Device profile 'Trident/7.0 | Windows 8.1 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1680x1050' is marked New and has never been used on C03042-K1
Card history holds 3 earlier closed cases (2 confirmed fraud, 1 cleared); most recent CC-3886 (card_not_present_new_device, confirmed_fraud)

Known-pattern definition matched to this case: Out-of-region use. Card-present purchases in a billing region the cardholder has no history in, while their normal activity continues at home. Several days of purchases in one new region is a trip, not a clone. Policy R2, R3.
Closed cases whose analyst notes read most like this investigation (vector search over ClosedCase.note_emb): CC-5111, CC-1960, CC-4521, CC-2014

case.summary: Transaction 3464869 ($599.94, online) triggered the real-time model at score 0.77 on November 17, 2016. Graph analysis recalibrated the fraud probability to 0.00 through two independent signals: the trained feature scorer's assessment and device/pattern analysis. The transaction matched the out-of-region use pattern but was correctly interpreted as legitimate travel activity—the cardholder's normal activity continues at home while this represents activity in region 327 over multiple days. Transaction allowed; case closed as no fraud.

stop_reason: Probability 0.01 with 2 independent signals meets the §6 stopping rule; the risk score alone did not hold up.
